fields.System.Title: CNT-403 — Variance rate by operator
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want to see whether variances cluster around particular
operators, so that I can offer training where it is needed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get variance rates attributed to the operator who last
  • moved stock in the affected location.
  • - Given counters, then I also get the rate at which their counts are overturned by a
  • recount.
  • - Given an operator with too few transactions to be meaningful, then they are excluded
  • rather than shown with a misleading rate.
  • - Given the report, then it is documented as a training signal, not a disciplinary
  • metric.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, platform |
| Tables | accuracy projection, stock_movement |
| Risks | Operator metrics driving dishonest short-pick reporting ([doc 01 §3](../../../docs/01-product-overview.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
